Maya (CSM): Heads-up: BrightMap reported increased latency during their guided onboarding demo this morning. They flagged it as material for renewal discussion. Need a short evidence pack + credit calc before the afternoon call.
Tom (AM): yikes. How long was the impact window? customer asks for concrete numbers.
Ravi (SRE): quick summary: p95 for /v1/embeddings spiked ~10x from baseline for ~11 minutes between 2026-03-20T14:03Z and 14:14Z. Root cause looks like concurrent scale-down + prefix cache cold starts. Query I used: `SELECT p95_ms, count(*) FROM requests WHERE customer='brightmap' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T14:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T14:30Z' GROUP BY 1`
Ana (Eng): probable autoscaler thrash. Short-term mitigation: raise min replicas on onboarding pool and enable prefix-warm for BrightMap's namespace. Longer-term: add scale hysteresis and improve warmup instrumentation.
Maya (CSM): customer needs an estimate for a goodwill credit. Any calc doc?
Ravi (SRE): per credit policy: if >10% of requests in billing window breach latency SLO for >10 minutes, we compute token-weighted exposure and produce credit. I can export traces + aggregated metrics to s3://redwood-evidence/brightmap/2026-03-20/ and produce a signed bundle.
Tom (AM): recommend offering a one-time 4% credit and an enablement session. Keeps renewal on track.
Ana (Eng): engineering can commit to toggling prefix-warm for onboarding pools by EOD and a follow-up autoscaler smoothing change in 2 weeks. 4% seems reasonable.
Maya (CSM): I'll draft the one-pager: impact summary, evidence link, proposed 4% credit, remediation milestones, and invite to an enablement walkthrough.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260320-72 opened. Owner: Ravi (SRE).
Ravi (SRE): uploading evidence bundle now, ETA ~4m. Will include sample request IDs, spans, and the scale event timeline.
Tom (AM): once evidence is in, I'll share the comms with Legal for quick sign-off.
Maya (CSM): action items: 1) Ravi: upload evidence + credit calc by 14:40 2) Ana: roll prefix-warm toggle to onboarding pools by EOD 3) Tom: confirm customer messaging + credit 4) Maya: finalize one-pager and present at the call.
Tom (AM): I'll set renewal flag to amber for now and propose the 4% in the call. If Legal pushes back, fall back to 3% + extended trial.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. I'll post the draft here for signoff 14:50.
